description: nf-core/mag samplesheet context, aligned to the pinned 5.5.0 schema. Metagenome assembly and binning.

skip_binqc.help: TRUE by curated default: bin QC needs a BUSCO/CheckM2 database and none is provisioned on Luria. Set false only once one is.

skip_gtdbtk.help: TRUE by curated default. GTDB-Tk otherwise auto-downloads a very large database mid-run, which is a poor surprise on a shared cluster.

coassemble_group.help: When true, samples sharing a `group` value are assembled together rather than individually.

run_busco.help: MUST be false while skip_binqc is true. mag 5.5.0 defaults run_busco to TRUE, and subworkflows/local/utils_nfcore_mag_pipeline/main.nf calls error() on the combination '--skip_binqc and --run_<tool>'. Leaving it at the pipeline default aborted the run at validation.

run_checkm.help: Same constraint as run_busco. Also needs a database we do not host.

run_checkm2.help: Same constraint as run_busco. Also needs a database we do not host.

pipeline.name: nf-core/mag
pipeline.core_rule: Columns are sample, run, group, short_reads_1, short_reads_2, long_reads. sample and group are REQUIRED. Note the read columns are NOT named fastq_1/fastq_2 — the emitter's PIPELINE_COLUMN_ALIASES handles the rename.
pipeline.reference_requirement: NONE. mag assembles de novo — there is no genome to resolve, and it declares no genome/fasta/gtf parameter. Its databases are all optional and are skipped by the curated defaults.

validation_rules: The file consumed by the pipeline must be comma-separated (CSV).
sample and group must both be populated.
Read columns are short_reads_1 / short_reads_2, NOT fastq_1 / fastq_2.
Default to one group per sample (individual assembly). Only share a group value when the user has explicitly asked for co-assembly, and set coassemble_group true when you do.
Do NOT pass --genome, --fasta or --gtf: mag declares none of them.
Bin QC and GTDB-Tk are OFF by default — do not report taxonomic classification or bin completeness as though they ran.

skip_binqc=true REQUIRES run_busco=false. mag defaults run_busco to true and error()s on the combination, so the pipeline-default value aborts the run before anything starts. Verified against the 5.5.0 workflow on 2026-08-05.

skip_binqc or skip_gtdbtk being true is what stops the GTDB-Tk database being staged: workflows/mag.nf sets `gtdb = params.skip_binqc || params.skip_gtdbtk ? false : params.gtdb_db`, and gtdb_db defaults to a remote GTDB R232 tarball. Keep both true unless that database is hosted.
notes: De novo metagenome assembly and binning. The `group` column decides what gets co-assembled, which is a scientific choice: state plainly which grouping was used.

sources.label: nf-core/mag nextflow_schema.json @ 5.5.0
sources.notes: Authoritative: NO required params. busco_db / checkm2_db / cat_db are optional; skip_binqc and skip_gtdbtk exist.

sources.label: nf-core/mag assets/schema_input.json @ 5.5.0
sources.notes: Authoritative: sample and group required; read columns are short_reads_1/2 and long_reads.

samplesheet_columns.description: Column-level field dictionary for the nf-core/mag input samplesheet.

group.description: Co-assembly grouping. Samples sharing a group value are assembled together when coassemble_group is set.
group.validation_hints: Default to the sample's own id (individual assembly). Only share values when the user asked for co-assembly.

run.description: Sequencing run identifier, for samples split across runs.
run.validation_hints: Leave blank unless the cohort genuinely spans runs.

short_reads_1.validation_hints: This is the fastq_1 equivalent — note the different column name.

long_reads.validation_hints: Only populate when the cohort genuinely has matched long reads.

report_writer_guidance.purpose: Build an nf-core/mag samplesheet from a resolved NExtSEEK D.SEQ cohort of metagenomic libraries.
report_writer_guidance.workflow_role: Selected for metagenome assembly / binning requests.
population_priority: One row per D.SEQ leaf; sample = the UID.
Set group = the sample's own id unless the user asked for co-assembly; if they did, group by the metadata field they named and set coassemble_group.
Map reads into short_reads_1 / short_reads_2, NOT fastq_1 / fastq_2.
State that bin QC and GTDB-Tk are off, and what enabling them would need.
final_checks: Every row has a group value.
The grouping choice was stated to the user.
